# Moukey v4.0.0

**First release under the name Moukey.** Moukey is a fork of [Mouser](https://github.com/TomBadash/Mouser) by Tom Badash, released under the same MIT license. This version renames the app, adds Logitech keyboard support, and brings in a batch of reliability fixes from the original project.

## ⌨️ Keyboards

Moukey now remaps Logitech HID++ keyboards alongside mice. A mouse and a keyboard can be connected at the same time, including through a single Unifying receiver.

- **Logitech Craft** (including the Crown dial) and **MX Keys**, with an interactive photo layout of the keys.
- Other Logitech HID++ keyboards are detected automatically and get a generic card with their remappable top-row keys.
- Top-row keys keep their native function until you remap them.
- Optional backlight that follows the system theme (on in dark mode, off in light mode).

**Fixed in this release:** a top-row key that you remapped in one profile stopped working in every profile where it was set to "Do Nothing", because the key stayed diverted away from Windows. Keys are now diverted only while the active profile remaps them, so they go back to their native function when you switch profile.

## 🔌 Sleep, wake and reconnect

- The mouse hook and HID++ connection recover after the PC sleeps or resumes, and repeated resume signals from Modern Standby are coalesced into one recovery.
- Saved device settings (DPI, SmartShift, wheel direction) are replayed when the mouse wakes or re-links.
- Gesture diverts lost after a re-link are detected and restored.

## 🖱️ Gestures and settings

- The jolt of pressing the gesture button no longer registers as a swipe.
- The chosen language is remembered across restarts, and Chinese, Japanese and Korean text renders with proper fonts.
- The Actions button sensitivity card is labelled and translated correctly.
- Fixed the SmartShift scroll-force section of the settings page, which referred to an element that did not exist.

## 🏷️ Renamed to Moukey

- The app, executable, packages and build files are now called Moukey (`Moukey.exe`, `Moukey-Windows.zip`).
- Settings live in `%APPDATA%\Moukey`. On first run your existing `config.json` is copied from the old `Mouser` folder; the old folder is left untouched.
- **If you had "start with Windows" enabled**, turn it on again in Settings: the startup entry is now named Moukey.
- Update checks now look at the Moukey releases instead of the original project.
- The license text ships with the app.

## 📝 Notes

- Tested on Windows. Linux and macOS packaging was renamed to match but not run on those systems for this release.
- Moukey is not affiliated with Logitech.
